_comment: Demo material asset (post-Editor-E8, renderer/MaterialData.h) -- targets the "ForwardLitColor" shader (ShaderPropertySchema.h) with a bright red tint, referenced by the hierarchy child cube in editor/assets/demo.scene.json to prove a material-tinted entity actually renders through ForwardLitColorPipeline instead of ForwardLitPipeline's own debug normal-color visualization. Raw JSON, no Cooker binary step (same reasoning as Scene/Prefab documents, see engine/scene/README.md); GUID-tagged via the .meta sidecar sitting right next to this file (m_demo_red.material.json.meta), same mechanism every other asset under assets/ uses. Migrated to the generic {shader, properties} shape (from a hardcoded tintColor-only shape) when material property editing grew to cover whatever properties a shader declares, not just a fixed tint -- see assets/m_demo_checker_tint.material.json for a second example using a Texture property.
